title: Stiff, hard shreds
text:
Stiff, hard shreds. This pillow is not right. It's almost as if the foam was old and dried out when it was made. The pillow is really thick and actually hard. Neither of us wants to sleep on it and even the dogs ignore it.

The pillow comes rolled in a tight tube instead of vacuum sealed flat. It never inflated evenly and still feels clumpy after 10 days. There are far better options out there than this pillow.
